title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — Late-Arrival Credit Line
content:
Harbison's arrival guarantee on Repair and Emergency Service Calls is honoured on the invoice. When the technician arrives late on a call in a class that carries the guarantee, the call's invoice receives one late-arrival credit line. That line names the visit's diagnostic fee line and the customer's agreement, and it lowers the balance owing on the call. The credit is owed once the call's record shows the late arrival.

## Posting tool: `post_on_time_credit_a011cbd0`

**What it does.** The tool posts the on-time arrival credit on the invoice of one service call whose technician arrived late. Each call of the tool adds one `late_arrival_credit` line to the call's invoice, dated today, naming the invoice line it is attached to and the Comfort Club agreement it was figured under. The call's invoice balance is lowered by exactly the amount given. The tool does not check eligibility or amounts; it books what it is given.

**How it is invoked.** This is a hidden agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it by the name `post_on_time_credit_a011cbd0`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ticket_id` | Reference number of the service call being credited | Id, read from the service call lookup |
| `source_line_id` | Reference number of the invoice line the credit names (the visit's diagnostic fee line) | Id, read from the call's invoice lines |
| `customer_id` | Customer reference number of the account holder | Id, read from the customer profile lookup |
| `agreement_id` | Reference number of the customer's Comfort Club agreement | Id, read from the agreement lookup |
| `recall_of_ticket_id` | Reference number of the earlier call this visit returns to under the repair guarantee, copied from the call record | Id; an empty string when the call record shows no earlier call |
| `amount` | The credit being posted | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; a value with more decimals is rounded to the cent half up when booked |

**Return.** The tool returns a receipt with `line_id` (reference number of the new credit line), `ticket_id`, `line_type` (always `late_arrival_credit`), `source_line_id` (the line named), `recall_of_ticket_id` (as passed), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `ticket_balance` (the call's invoice balance in USD after the credit). A receipt carrying a `line_id` means the credit is on the invoice. The credit shows at once among the call's invoice lines and in the call's new balance.
